note: Polio is a highly infectious viral disease. The polio virus invades the nervous system and can cause irreversible paralysis.
title: Number of one-year-olds who have not received the inactivated polio vaccine
subtitle: The [inactivated polio vaccine](#dod:inactivated-polio-vaccine) (IPV1) protects children against polioviruses types 1, 2 and 3. In countries where risk of polio is higher, IPV is given alongside the [oral polio vaccine](#dod:oral-polio-vaccine) (OPV). In countries where the risk of polio is low, only the IPV is recommended.
